analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price($149.58) vs SMA5($163.22)/SMA20($175.28)/SMA50($167.44): indicating short- to mid-term trend below moving averages.
· Below SMA100($152.98), above SMA200($142.20): suggesting potential shift to a weaker mid- to long-term trend.
· 52-week position (46.9%) + current price level near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (42.4→27.0): entering oversold territory, confirming downward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-3.1490→-3.1371): bearish trend continuation, dead cross maintained.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Lower band $154.55): approaching lower band, band width at 23.66%.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($141.24): confirmed support based on SMA200.
· Swing resistance ($150.19): positioned below Pivot R1($178.34).
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Lower Low): confirming continuation of downtrend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (3.17x 5-day average): sharp increase in volume accompanying price drop, indicating strong selling pressure.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase): insufficient grounds for buy entry, maintaining a wait-and-see approach.
